entries.name: Banana OG Autoflower
entries.genetics: Banana OG S1 #21 x Mint Jelly Auto x Banana OG Auto Bx3
entries.description: A classic emerald triangle clone circa 2010, coveted and preserved by growers in Humboldt’s coastal surf village Trinidad, now recreated in stable seed form. At HSC we occasionally get the opportunity to keep a clone strain’s flame burning through our process of backcrossing and selfing a clone until the seed line consistently displays the traits of the original clone. We’re proud to have done this with many Emerald Triangle clone classics, Trainwreck and Headband, to name a few and for a strain to reach levels of notoriety in the worlds cannabis strain capital we know it must be special. Banana OG is insanely productive, has that very popular candy gas terpene profile and surprised us with excellent yield as a washer, both in its photoperiod form as well as our autoflower conversion. Expect giant colas that are frosty green with attractive purple highlights and THC averaging over 25% in both photo and autoflower form. The Banana OG also displayed resistance to PM, OG’s nemesis as well as other fungal pathogens. A great strain for rosin folks or eclectic growers and brands that want to differentiate themselves with a cult classic.

entries.description: Durban Poison made waves in Humboldt back in the late nineties and a select few legacy cultivators made a point of preserving clones even though the longer flowering time made it less desirable for commercial production. In 2021 we were gifted the original Durban cut and we set out to stabilize it as an autoflower seed line, a process that takes several years and at least four generations of sifting through progeny to keep true to type traits from the original photoperiod version. Fortunately, we kept seed from a minty phenotype of our Mint Jelly Auto, which happens to hold a autoflower world record for THC content, was a great place to start the transition of the Durban Poison into an auto. As expected, the Durban Poison isn’t our quickest auto, taking up to 100 days from sprout to harvest, but the reward in yield, cannabinoid content and terpenes make up for the extra couple weeks. entries.description: Puff Pastry is a cultivator’s dream, combining ease of growth with exceptional yields. This hybrid strain balances invigorating sativa effects with some soothing indica relaxation. It’s adaptable to various environments, thriving indoors and out, and boasts two robust genetics that resist common cannabis diseases. Growing the Puff Pastry is straightforward, ideal for both the novice and seasoned growers. Its vigor results in gigantic, bulbous buds rich in dense, sticky resin, making it produce ample light white colored rosin. Indoors, expect prolific yields per square meter, while outdoor cultivation promises even more abundant harvests. Aromatic complexity defines Puff Pastry’s terps, featuring rich, chocolate and cinnamon notes followed by bright citrus and some classic OG fuel. Each smooth puff glides effortlessly, leaving a sweet, lingering aftertaste. This strain is super versatile, perfect for sparking daytime creativity or unwinding at night. Puff Pastry offers a harmonious, easy peasy cultivation journey coupled with a plentiful, high-quality bounty, making it more than a strain it’s an enriching experience for both grower and consumer alike.
